name: ColorPicker
description:
A colour picker in OKLCH, the space the library's palettes use: an area of lightness and
chroma at the chosen hue (colours the screen cannot show are drawn faintly, and choosing one
moves to the nearest colour that can be shown), a hue slider, an optional opacity slider, a
hex field, preset swatches and the browser's eyedropper where available. Values are hex.

Keyboard: in the area, ↑ ↓ change lightness and ← → chroma (Shift for larger steps, Page
Up/Down for lightness by 10%, Home/End for no chroma and the most); with `plane="hsv"` they
change value and saturation likewise. The sliders follow the slider pattern. The planes
run left to right in every language, like a chart.
signature: ({ value, defaultValue, onValueChange, onValueCommit, alpha, plane, size, swatches, eyeDropper, disabled, locale, labels, className, id, "aria-label": ariaLabel, "aria-labelledby": ariaLabelledBy, }: ColorPickerProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: alpha
props.description: Offer an opacity slider and keep alpha in the value (`#rrggbbaa`). Default false.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the picker group when no visible label names it.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: IDs of elements that name the picker.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The starting colour when uncontrolled. Default: a mid blue.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: eyeDropper
props.description: Offer the browser's eyedropper where it has one (`window.EyeDropper`). Default true.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable element or component identifier.

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<{ picker: string; area: string; areaValue: (lightness: number, chroma: number) => string; areaHsv: string; areaValueHsv: (saturation: number, brightness: number) => string; hue: string; alpha: string; hex: string; eyeDropper: string; swatches: string; open: string; none: string; clear: string; }> | undefined

props.name: locale
props.description: Formatting and wording locale; defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new hex colour on every change, while dragging too.

props.name: onValueCommit
props.description: Called with the hex colour when a change is finished: the pointer is released, a key is pressed, a swatch is chosen or the hex field commits.

props.name: plane
props.description:
The plane under the hue slider. `oklch` (default) is lightness by chroma at the OKLCH hue,
the space the library's palettes use; `hsv` is saturation by value at the HSV hue, the plane
most design tools show. Either way the value is hex and the hue slider follows the plane.

props.name: size
props.description: `md` (default) or `sm`, a compact picker with a shorter plane and tighter spacing for tool panels.

props.name: swatches
props.description: Preset colours shown under the controls.

props.name: value
props.description: The colour as hex (`#rrggbb`, or `#rrggbbaa` with `alpha`). Pair with `onValueChange` to control it.
